title: It wasn’t the Right Mountain, Mohammad
description: God, Abraham, Isaac, a lost shepherdess and a herd of antelopes appear in this ancient tale which has been transposed to a new digital world; a world in which no one is innocent and where the things which we search for – and eventually find – are destined to be lost again.
music: Eliav Varda In a small Belarusian village where time seems to stand still
has to deal with her mother‘s death. Her father decides to send her to an orphanage. But one day she decides to run away home.
